What happens when a movie becomes more than just entertainment?

At our Mindset Movie Screening, students watched, reflected and discussed the lessons they could take back to their UPSC preparation.

And this is what stayed with one of them.

🎬 Another screening is coming up.

🎬Movies for Mental Health | A Special Screening for UPSC Aspirants 
🎟 Free Entry | Register Here: https://tinyurl.com/4r9k6mpb

UPSC preparation can bring stress, self-doubt, and burnout, making it harder to stay focused and consistent.

This 13 September, join us for a special movie screening followed by an interactive discussion with Sonali Ma'am, UPSC Mindset Coach, where you can understand these challenges better, learn healthier ways to deal with them, and return to your preparation with better clarity and perspective.

📅 13 September 2026
🕠 5:30 PM to 7:30 PM
📍 Ganga Hall, LevelUp IAS

Because a healthy mindset helps you prepare better and sustain the journey.

Queries? Call at 8826496658

Meet us - 📍Location: LevelUp IAS, Karol Bagh Centre; Google Map - https://maps.app.goo.gl/6brt5mwLSFhENRCq8
Address - 2nd Floor, 45 Pusa Road, Opp. Metro Pillar 128, Karol Bagh
